responsibility: Provides the non-C++ stub implementation of the Solaris C++ mangling-context hook. It returns NULL_TREE for TARGET_CXX_DECL_MANGLING_CONTEXT so non-C++ frontends can link Solaris target support without depending on cp/ code or applying Solaris-specific namespace remapping. This file exists as a linkage stub, not as the real Solaris C++ ABI policy implementation.
